mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested a strict split between kitchen_table_k1 (early morning) and desk_o1 (late morning/afternoon). Today's evidence shows this is incorrect. The mug was at kitchen_table_k1 at 09:56, but moved to desk_o1 by 11:05 and stayed there until 16:38. Crucially, it was at cupboard_k1 at 21:25. The assumption that it remains at the office desk in the evening is wrong. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning (pre-10:00), desk_o1 for mid-day (11:00-17:00), and cupboard_k1 for late evening (20:00+).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for late morning and early evening. Today, it was at desk_o1 at 11:01, confirming the mid-day location. No new errors for other time slots. Continue checking desk_o1 for late morning (09:00-12:00) and early evening (18:00-21:00).

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for the workday. Today, it was at desk_o1 at 12:06, confirming it stays at the office desk during the day. The previous assumption to check nightstand_b1 for late afternoon was incorrect. Check desk_o1 for all daytime queries (09:00-18:00). For late night (22:00+), continue checking nightstand_b1 as no new data contradicts this.

book_tomas: No new errors today. Continue checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and bed_b1 for late night (22:00+).

glass_tomas: No new errors today. Continue checking kitchen_table_k1 for mid-day (12:00-14:00) and nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+).

new_item: coffee_table_l1: On Day 27 at 20:56, an item was found at coffee_table_l1 when dining_table_d1 was guessed. This appears to be a one-off or specific to that time slot, but note that living room furniture (coffee table) is a valid location for items in the evening, distinct from the dining table.
